## MiniMax H3 Max API

MiniMax H3 Max is a text to video, image to video, reference to video and multi-angle video model by MiniMax, available on the Venice API as `minimax-h3-max-text-to-video`. This model is private and no prompt data is stored in any capacity.

MiniMax H3 Max is a post-trained variant of MiniMax's H3 video model. This text-to-video variant generates 5- to 15-second clips at up to 1080p with native stereo audio.

### MiniMax H3 Max API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-h3-max-text-to-video` | Text to video | Private | from $0.045 / sec |
| `minimax-h3-max-image-to-video` | Image to video | Private | from $0.045 / sec |
| `minimax-h3-max-reference-to-video` | Reference to video | Private | from $0.06 / sec |
| `minimax-h3-max-multi-angle` | Multi-angle | Private | from $0.045 / sec |

Clip prices for `minimax-h3-max-text-to-video` with audio:

| Duration | 480p | 768p | 1080p |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per second | $0.045 | $0.072 | $0.144 |
| 5s | $0.22 | $0.36 | $0.72 |
| 10s | $0.45 | $0.72 | $1.44 |
| 15s | $0.68 | $1.08 | $2.16 |

Any length from 5 to 15 seconds, priced per second.

### MiniMax H3 Max specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | MiniMax |
| Released | Aug 27, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |

| Audio | Always generated |

### How to use the MiniMax H3 Max API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "minimax-h3-max-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-h3-max-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "480P",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready (JSON with the status until then)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "minimax-h3-max-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4

# If the queue response has a download_url, retrieve only reports the
# status: download the MP4 from that URL once it is COMPLETED.
```
